facade.description: Original visual synthesis from current custodian photo and restoration elevation; approximate depths, not a surveyed XYZ facade.

sampling.adaptiveControls: Additional stations at window jambs, rounded corners, lintels and cornice transitions; minimum added spacing 0.12m horizontal / 0.09m vertical

facade.uncertainty: Floor heights, depths, bevel widths and intermediate profiles are estimated from registered primary visual references; plan, roof and rooftop positions retain municipal/OSM/ICGC measurements.

replacementEnvelope.method: Union only the nearby street-facing RTT fragments with the physical mesh projection. Bound the fragments by the two party-wall planes; keep courtyard holes. Do not deform the GLB.
replacementEnvelope.overlapMethod: Expand the retained street fragments 0.05m, intersect the expansion with the physical mesh envelope, and union that inward overlap with the unchanged exterior fragments.
